## Player-facing change

What behaviour becomes possible, different or clearer to the two players?

## Scope

Which design milestone / issue does this address?

## Verification

- [ ] Typecheck
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Build
- [ ] Two independent browser contexts (when multiplayer/networking changes)
- [ ] Manual playtest of any changed social mechanic (when relevant)

Record commands actually run, and any tests unavailable in your environment.

## Information asymmetry

If the change touches network messages, state or observations: what can each player now see, and what remains private?

## Out of scope / follow-ups

List deliberate omissions. Avoid silently expanding the architecture.
